submission.justification: Mixture-G1 at a 2.0 mm gap gave the best simulated time resolution: 0.935 ns, versus 1.304 ns for the best G2 gap (2.0 mm) and 2.102 ns for the best G3 gap (2.0 mm). G1 was best at 2.0 mm among the 0.5 mm steps scanned from 1.0 to 3.0 mm. The gap scan was coarse and no finer scan was run, so the true optimum may lie slightly away from 2.0 mm. The recommendation is NOT yet cleared for use. No lab environmental or safety policy documents were found (num_policy_documents_found = 0), so compliance for all three candidates is unverified and none was confirmed compliant or eliminated. G1 must have its gas system checked against the laboratory's environmental and safety policies before adoption. If G1 fails that check, G2 at 2.0 mm (1.304 ns) is the next-best option, subject to the same check.
